notes: ARCHETYPE: copy with `lotr template new NAME --archetype mcp-oauth-preregistered`, then replace every TODO.
Use this when the server does not register clients itself: you create an OAuth app in the service's settings and get a client id (and usually a client secret).
Register the redirect address http://127.0.0.1:8977/callback (the port is connect.redirect_port).
lotr setup asks for the client id and secret as REFERENCES (store:NAME-client-id, store:NAME-client-secret); they are never in this file. Set client_secret_required false for a public client.
